w: Swamishri left Vidyanagar at 5.30 pm and arrived for darshan in Vadtal at 6.00 pm. Swamishri prostrated before the murti of Harikrishna Maharaj and did darshan of the holy relics of Shriji Maharaj.

Swamishri then went to Dabhan and offered his respects at the shrine that commemorates the diksha place of Gunatitanand Swami. After doing darshan at the old mandir Swamishri came to the Akshar Purushottam Mandir and addressed the assembly.
In the morning, Swamishri was engaged in a meeting regarding the BAPS earthquake relief work.

In the evening assembly, Shri Harikrishna Maharaj was festively welcomed into the assembly by costumed kishores carrying Him in a decorated palanquin. Thakorji was heralded in a festive and celebrative spirit and finally brought on stage. The assembly concluded with Swamishri's blessings and honor accorded to Harikrishna Maharaj.

In the evening Children’s Day program, children wonderfully performed a parayan on the Bhaktachintamani with all the rituals of pujan and arti. Swamishri showered his blessings on the children and addressed the assembly.
After his morning puja, Swamishri performed the pratishtha rituals of the murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj for the BAPS hari mandir in Hiravadi, Amdavad.
Today, Swamishri was going to have his routine cardiac check up.

At 9.00 am Swamishri departed from Dadar Mandir after Thakorji’s darshan for his cardiac tests at Jaslok Hospital. Dr Ashwinbhai Mehta, Dr Kiranbhai Doshi, Dr K.N. Patel, Dr Panchal, Dr Sanjaybhai Patel, Dr Samirbhai and others were in Swamishri’s service. In the afternoon Swamishri was injected with the Thaliun dye and thereafter scanned with a nuclear imaging machine. At 4.30 pm Swamishri blessed the doctors and departed for Dadar Mandir. Thereafter Swamishri took a little rest. At 8.45 pm Swamishri had dinner and after a meeting retired for the night at 10.30 pm. Overall the tests showed that Swamishri’s health was fine. The final results were to arrive after two days on Monday. In the afternoon the President of India H.E. Abdul Kalam had phoned to say that he too would pray to God for Swamishri’s health.
Devotees and dignitaries had prayed for Swamishri health.
Swamishri reached Swaminarayan Akshardham at 8.45 p.m. There was also a fireworks display.

Swamishri travelled from Gandhinagar to Himatnagar. After having darshan and performing arti of Thakorji at the BAPS hari mandir Swamishri came to the new mandir site. The primary rituals for the foundation-stone laying ceremony were performed by Mahant Swami, Dr Swami, Ishwarcharan Swami and Viveksagar Swami.

On Swamishri’s arrival at the site the satsang assembly was in progress. The senior sadhus had addressed the huge congregation of 6,570 participants and well-wishers. Swamishri was honoured with garlands by senior and other sadhus. Thereafter Swamishri blessed the occasion, “By the grace of God and his holy sadhu there has been steady progress in this region. Here, our sadhus travel to the tribal villages of Poshina to transform and elevate the lives of others. True progress means to become addiction-free, stop stealing and take to honest ways of earning one’s living. Progress also means experiencing inner peace. Yes, we tend to believe that progress merely lies in earning and amassing wealth, but then we will not have inner peace. This inner peace can be attaned through mandirs, God and his holy sadhu. We gain this inner peace through imbibing our culture. Bhagwan Swaminarayan came on earth with the purpose of liberating souls.” Swamishri also mentioned Gopalanand Swami, who was born in Todla as Khushal Bhatt and how he used to play with the murti of Bhagwan Shyamlaji. In conclusion, Swamishri appreciated the services of all devotees, government and municipal officials. In all, 25,000 devotees and guests were served mahaprasad (Photos in March 2010 issue, back cover).

Today was the foundation ceremony of the shikharbaddh mandir in Himmatnagar. Swamishri had come here from Gandhinagar especially for this and was to return to Gandhinagar. Thousands of devotees gathered for the ceremony. Swamishri went into the foundation pit of the shikharbaddh mandir, worshipped the stones and performed the foundation stone ceremony.

Many sadhus were present, and hundreds of devotees who had donated. The leading devotees among them were coming before the pit to take part, placing cement on the stones. Amid so many devotees, Swamishri remembered and called Virchandbhai, a founding devotee of this area. In the same way he remembered Shrirang Swami, who had first toured this region and spread satsang in the tribal areas and the Himmatnagar region. Swamishri himself had called him especially from Mumbai for this occasion. Everyone saw how lasting a place each person's seva has in Swamishri's memory!

ds.t: It all happens by their grace
w: At the age of 90, Swamishri had begun building new shikharbaddh mandirs. With this in mind, tonight as Swamishri sat on his bed to rest, a sadhu said, "Everyone says that at 90 you have tremendous courage. Even at this age you are building new shikharbaddh mandirs. You have great courage."
Swamishri said, "What are we? Whatever there is, is His grace. It happens by the glory of Maharaj and Swami. Everything happens by the resolve and blessings of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj."
